invariants.rationale: The method immediately dereferences result, so it must not be null.
getWriteStatuses() is called before being used, so it must not return null.
getPartitionToReplaceFileIds() is used in building commit metadata, so it must not return null.
Typically, the setCommitMetadata operation is meaningful only if there are write statuses to commit. This may hold depending on the domain logic.
